SELECT DISTINCT media_type, media_tmdb_id
		 FROM availability_history
		 WHERE country_code = ? AND streaming_type IN (?, ?, ?) AND dropped_on IS NULL AND appeared_source <> 'backfill' AND (CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) >= ?
		 ORDER BY media_type, media_tmdb_id
		 LIMIT 1000000

SELECT media_tmdb_id, streaming_service_id, min(CASE WHEN appeared_source <> 'backfill' THEN (CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) ELSE 0 END), dropped_on, min(created_at)
				 FROM availability_history
				 WHERE country_code = ? AND streaming_type IN (?, ?, ?) AND (dropped_on IS NULL OR dropped_on >= ?) AND media_type = ? AND media_tmdb_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
				 GROUP BY media_tmdb_id, streaming_service_id, dropped_on
				 LIMIT 1000000

SELECT media_tmdb_id, streaming_service_id, min(CASE WHEN appeared_source <> 'backfill' THEN (CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) ELSE 0 END), dropped_on, min(created_at)
				 FROM availability_history
				 WHERE country_code = ? AND streaming_type IN (?, ?, ?) AND (dropped_on IS NULL OR dropped_on >= ?) AND media_type = ? AND media_tmdb_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
				 GROUP BY media_tmdb_id, streaming_service_id, dropped_on
				 LIMIT 1000000

SELECT date_trunc('day', CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END), count(*), count(DISTINCT media_type || ':' || cast(media_tmdb_id AS TEXT)) FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = 'US' AND streaming_type IN ('flatrate','free','ads') AND appeared_source <> 'backfill' AND dropped_on IS NULL AND created_at >= '2026-10-17T00:13:00Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000000
